steps.title: Configure project package and gradle build environment
steps.description: Configure Gradle 8.5 build settings, target SDK 34, compile SDK 34, and Temurin 17 Java 8 source compatibility.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest and permissions
steps.description: Declare foreground service media playback, internet access, wake lock, post notifications permissions, and activity metadata in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Setup API schema and app metadata configuration
steps.description: Set up api_schema.json and app-meta.json for offline backend capability and identity storage.

steps.title: Configure application strings, color definitions, and dark material theme
steps.description: Define resource strings, dark theme colors, and custom styles in strings.xml, colors.xml, and styles.xml.

steps.title: Create XML drawables and vector icons
steps.description: Create custom vector drawables for player actions, navigation buttons, card containers, and paywall action controls.

steps.title: Define watch history layout components
steps.description: Construct activity_history.xml and item_history.xml layouts for history display and item actions.

steps.title: Define main application view hierarchy and paywall overlay
steps.description: Build activity_main.xml layout containing main Web View content, navigation bar, error container, and lock screen paywall overlay.

steps.title: Implement HistoryItem data model
steps.description: Define HistoryItem Java class to encapsulate watch history record fields including id, title, url, and timestamp.

steps.title: Implement SQLite helper database manager
steps.description: Develop HistoryDbHelper to create, query, insert, and delete video watch history items locally.

steps.title: Implement watch history ListView adapter
steps.description: Create HistoryAdapter to bind HistoryItem records to custom item views and handle item deletion clicks.

steps.title: Implement background audio foreground service
steps.description: Create BackgroundAudioService with MediaSession, wake lock, audio focus management, and notification media controls.

steps.title: Implement paywall access status and remote verification manager
steps.description: Create TrialPaywallManager to query access status, manage device ID generation, cache UPI details, and evaluate plan status.

steps.title: Implement HistoryActivity UI controller
steps.description: Create HistoryActivity to render the history list, support item navigation, handle selection results, and clear history records.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity web integration and background audio bridge
steps.description: Create MainActivity to configure WebView settings, inject JavaScript audio bridge, handle background playback state, and enforce paywall locking.

steps.title: Building LockPlayTube
steps.description: Compile and build final LockPlayTube APK package.
